page.overview:
Who is Edesina Azzedin?

Edesina is handsome and slender, with waist-length black hair.

Edesina is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Given she is Yellow Ajah, she would have an above average ability at Healing.

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the Aiel War when the Dragon was reborn. Accepted Edesina asks Alanna and Pritalle to loan her stockings in preparation for the bounty collection.
